hints: Start by picturing what type of addition happens when HCN adds to an aldehyde like propanal.
Draw the cyanohydrin product, CH3CH2CH(OH)CN, and list the new functional groups it contains.
Match each new group to its IR fingerprint, the C triple bond N, the O-H and the C-O, to see which statements hold.
walkthrough:
**Write the product of the reaction**

Propanal is an aldehyde, so HCN undergoes nucleophilic addition to the C=O bond to form a cyanohydrin.

Chemical equation or calculation rule if applicable:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO} + \text{HCN} \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH(OH)CN}$$
The product is 2-hydroxybutanenitrile. It contains both an alcohol group ($\text{-OH}$) and a nitrile group ($\text{-C}\equiv\text{N}$).

**Check statement 1 for the nitrile**

The $\text{C}\equiv\text{N}$ triple bond gives a weak, sharp absorption around 2200-2250 $\text{cm}^{-1}$.

Chemical equation or calculation rule if applicable:
$$\text{-C}\equiv\text{N} \rightarrow \text{weak absorption at 2200-2250 cm}^{-1}$$
Since the product contains $\text{-CN}$, statement 1 is present and correct.

**Check statements 2 and 3 for the alcohol**

The new $\text{-OH}$ group gives two characteristic absorptions, a strong broad O-H stretch at 3200-3600 $\text{cm}^{-1}$ and a strong C-O stretch at 1040-1300 $\text{cm}^{-1}$.

Chemical equation or calculation rule if applicable:
$$\text{-O-H stretch} \rightarrow 3200\text{-}3600 \text{ cm}^{-1}, \quad \text{C-O stretch} \rightarrow 1040\text{-}1300 \text{ cm}^{-1}$$
Both are present in the cyanohydrin, so statements 2 and 3 are also correct. All three together gives option A.

options.A: Correct because the product contains both C triple bond N and an alcohol. This gives all three absorptions: weak nitrile at 2200-2250, strong O-H at 3200-3600, and strong C-O at 1040-1300 cm-1.
options.B: Incorrect because it omits one of the true absorptions. Students choose this if they remember the nitrile and O-H but forget that alcohols also show a strong C-O stretch in the fingerprint region.
options.C: Incorrect because it omits the nitrile absorption. Students choose this if they focus only on the new OH group and forget the product is a cyanohydrin that still contains C triple bond N.
options.D: Incorrect because it includes only the nitrile. Students choose this if they think only the CN from HCN matters and miss that addition across C=O also creates a new C-OH alcohol group.
